verdict.rationale: An llms.txt at deepmind.google contains Veo-specific agent-readable guidance: formatting rules, cinematic parameter notation, camera motion and lighting tokens. However, the developer API docs domain has no llms.txt (ai.google.dev/llms.txt returns 404). That is a different host, so it limits coverage rather than contradicting the claim. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs on the developer/API docs site (ai.google.dev), evidence of how deep the deepmind.google llms.txt goes, and hands-on or independent confirmation that agents can use it effectively.
